5176:
Foundation is an entry point that comes before the first year of university. By studying a foundation, students will gain a solid understanding of their chosen subject as well as the required skills for study at a UK university. Upon successful completion of foundation, they will progress directly to first year or to international year one

This degree provides valuable insight into the worlds of accountancy practice, commerce, industry and finance. Teaching is delivered through a blend of lectures, workshops, field trips and online learning. During the course, students will gain expertise in the following areas:

  • Financial and management accounting
  • Corporate finance
  • International accounting and finance issues
  • Data analysis
  • Business technology.
51gw:
Pre-Master’s is an entry point that comes before a Master’s degree. By studying Pre-Master’s, students will gain a solid understanding of their chosen subject as well as the required skills for postgraduate-level study at a UK university. Upon successful completion, students will progress to their Master’s degree.

The course is designed to meet the needs of contemporary businesses around the globe. Students will graduate with expertise in the following areas:

  • Strategy
  • Marketing
  • Leadership
  • Finance
  • Entrepreneurship
  • Operations and project management.
